NeckHurt Hub

NeckHurt Hub is a clean Rayfield‑based local script focused on movement, camera control, visuals, and quality‑of‑life features.
It’s made to be simple, smooth, and actually usable in most games without killing performance or breaking stuff.

Created by murasredo.
